headline: Arman Financial Services receives credit rating revision
hook: Rating action on Arman Financial Services
summary: Arman Financial Services Limited has informed the stock exchanges regarding a revision in its credit ratings. The company is a non-banking financial company (NBFC) operating in microfinance and two-wheeler loans. Credit rating revisions directly impact borrowing costs and credit availability for lenders. Retail investors holding shares or debt instruments of the company should assess potential changes in its cost of funds.
whats_next: Detailed rating rationale release by the credit rating agency
why_it_matters: Lending costs for the company may change based on the rating.
